injuries.name: Torey Krug
injuries.note: Krug's move to long-term injured reserve was partially a financial decision, as it allows the Blues to exceed the salary cap by $4 million. The 35-year-old blueliner hasn't played since the 2023-24 campaign, but he hasn't officially ruled out a return. Regardless of when he decides to hang up his skates, the 13-year NHL veteran will be remembered as an excellent two-way player, as he currently sits at 483 points, 621 hits and 832 blocked shots across 778 regular-season outings.

injuries.name: Tyler Tucker
injuries.note: Based on Tucker's timeline, he shouldn't be expected back until mid-November, though it could certainly be longer. With Logan Mailloux (hand) also sidelined long-term, Adam Jiricek could see an extended run on the blue line. For his part, even once cleared to play, Tucker is unlikely to offer much in the way of fantasy value given his limited offensive upside.

injuries.name: Nate Schmidt
injuries.note: The Mammoth indicated Monday that Schmidt was considered out indefinitely, and he was officially placed on injured reserve. It isn't particularly surprising to see him labeled as week-to-week, and it indicates that he's unlikely to return after spending the minimum amount of time on IR. It seems likely that the 35-year-old will be sidelined until at least late November.

injuries.name: Dillon Dube
injuries.note: Neck: The Blues said on Saturday (Oct. 10) that Dube will be out of action for at least eight weeks and placed on Injured Reserve.

injuries.name: Adam Jecho
injuries.note: Personal: The St. Louis Blues placed F Adam Jecho on injured reserve non-roster list

injuries.name: Torey Krug
injuries.note: Ankle: The Blues placed Krug on season-ending long-term injured reserve on Thursday (Oct. 22), per PuckPedia.

injuries.name: Tyler Tucker
injuries.note: Knee: The St. Louis Blues said on Wednesday (Sept. 30) that Tucker underwent a successful arthroscopic procedure on his right knee and will be re-evaluated in six weeks.

injuries.name: Logan Cooley
injuries.note: Upper Body: Cooley is OUT for Thursday's (Nov. 12) game versus the Blues.

injuries.name: Dylan Guenther
injuries.note: Upper Body: The Utah Mammoth placed F Dylan Guenther on injured reserve on Wednesday (Nov. 11).

injuries.name: Maveric Lamoureux
injuries.note: Shoulder: The Utah Mammoth placed D Maveric Lamoureux on injured reserve and will miss 4-6 months following surgery to repair a dislocated shoulder.

injuries.name: John Marino
injuries.note: Upper Body: The Utah Mammoth placed D John Marino on injured reserve on Sunday (Nov. 1).

injuries.name: Nick Schmaltz
injuries.note: Lower Body: Schmaltz is Out for Thursday's (Nov. 12) matchup against the Blues.

injuries.name: Nate Schmidt
injuries.note: Upper Body: The Utah Mammoth said on Thursday (Nov. 12) that Schmidt is considered week-to-week, per Cole Bagley of KSL Sports.
